# fernwatch
fernwatch is a small tool for logging greenhouse sensor readings. It runs on a laptop and needs no network access.
Problems that occured during a run are listed at the end.
## Why
We needed a quick way to keep a record of temperatures overnight. Existing tools were either too heavy or too fragile for the field team.
## Install
Copy the folder somewhere on your path and make sure the interpreter is available. There are no external packages.
## Usage
Run it with the config file as the first argument. Output is written next to the input and the original is never modified.
The default settings are conservative; raise the limits only if you know your machine can cope.
## Known issues
Beginning with version two, the format is stable.
Very large inputs can be slow, and the progress bar is not accurate on the first pass.
Until the first run completes, nothing is written.
If you receive an error about locked files, close the other program and try again.
## Contributing
Please open an issue before sending a patch. We will respond within a few days, usually sooner.
Keep changes small and include a short description of the problem you are solving.
## Licence
It is necessary to restart after changing the config.
The environment variable is optional.
Released under a permissive licence. See the licence file for the details.
